dedupe_keys.name: eurocontrol aviation data repository for research adrr

description: The Aviation Data Repository for Research (ADRR) is EUROCONTROL's archive of detailed air traffic data for research and development. It holds detailed flight information, planned and actual flight trajectories, airspace structure and route network information for commercial flights operating in and over Europe, built from flight plans enriched with live data from air navigation service providers' flight data systems, radar and datalink, and merged with the route network in force at the time. The archive held about 28 million flights by July 2026, adding about 3 million flights a year from 2015 to 2024, with four months of flight data per year. Coverage is continental (European airspace). Downloads are free: users register with OneSky Online, request access to the dataset, agree to the terms of use, which each user signs, and then download; a guide and a sample dataset describe the structure, and access is open for all R&D use. Caveats: only sample months of each year are included, the terms of use restrict purposes to research, and the data reflect the air traffic management view, not airline operations. The trajectories and airspace data support air traffic flow, capacity and delay propagation studies and the calibration of airspace simulators. They complement the BADA aircraft performance model and are related to the OpenSky Network data.
